profile.headline: Senior Front End Developer
profile.summary: Senior front-end web developer with over 13 years of experience delivering high-performance web solutions for enterprise clients. Skilled in leveraging front-end technologies such as React.js, with deep expertise in user experience and design systems. Ability to improvise, troubleshoot, take ownership, and learn new skills on the job. Working with clients to gather requirements and come up with the best solutions, as well as leading cross disciplinary teams in iteration through the process. Experience with delivering  both large and small scale B2B interactive website experiences.
